_meta.title: RIFT Fault Injection Framework Specification
_meta.honest_caveat: Fault injection has not been executed on live Online Boutique. Framework is specified and ready for Linux deployment.

manifest_verification.held_out_test_status: UNTOUCHED — not inspected during tuning phases

NETWORK_LATENCY.causal_mechanism: tc netem per-destination latency injection increases RTT between source and target, propagating elevated lat_p99 upstream through the call graph

PACKET_LOSS.causal_mechanism: tc netem per-destination packet loss on the cart↔redis_cart link causes retransmissions and elevated error rates, propagating to upstream callers

SERVICE_DEGRADATION.causal_mechanism: stress-ng CPU load (90%) on the payment pod increases processing latency, causing checkout and frontend to accumulate lat_p99 increases

RESOURCE_CONTENTION.causal_mechanism: stress-ng memory pressure (80% of pod memory) on redis_cart pod causes evictions and increased response latency, propagating through cart, checkout, and frontend

QUEUEING.causal_mechanism: hey flood (concurrency=200) saturates the checkout request queue, causing queue depth spike and lat_p99 propagation to payment, shipping, email, and frontend

DEPENDENCY_FAILURE.causal_mechanism: tc 100% packet drop to product_catalog IP simulates OOM crash / hard failure; recommendation and frontend cascade to elevated error rates

MULTI_CAUSE.causal_mechanism: Simultaneous payment CPU spike (stress-ng) and shipping latency (tc netem); checkout receives degraded responses from both dependencies, causing frontend cascade. Requires compositional injection of two sub-faults.

confounded_scenarios.mechanism: Latent host-level confounder U_host (shared physical CPU saturation) affects both services in a pair simultaneously; the correlation is spurious, not causal.
confounded_scenarios.rift_expected_action: abstain when CID score is below threshold (L1)
confounded_scenarios.injection_approach: OBSERVATION_ONLY — U_host is not directly injectable via tc/stress-ng; treat as passive observation scenarios

fault_injection_record_schema.fault_id: string — fault identifier from manifest (e.g. NL_01)
fault_injection_record_schema.scenario_id: string — scenario UUID assigned at runtime
fault_injection_record_schema.injected_at: float | null — unix timestamp of injection command; null in dry_run
fault_injection_record_schema.verified_at: float | null — unix timestamp of independent verification; null until verify_injection() runs
fault_injection_record_schema.injection_verified: bool — set ONLY by verify_injection(), never by inject(). False until verified.
fault_injection_record_schema.verification_method: string — description of the independent measurement method used
fault_injection_record_schema.measured_delta: float | null — independently measured change (ms, %, count)
fault_injection_record_schema.expected_delta: float | null — expected change from scenario spec
fault_injection_record_schema.rollback_at: float | null — unix timestamp of rollback; null until rollback() runs
fault_injection_record_schema.status: enum: PENDING | INJECTED | VERIFIED | VERIFICATION_FAILED | ROLLED_BACK | ABORTED | DRY_RUN
fault_injection_record_schema.record_id: string — UUID generated at record creation
fault_injection_record_schema.network_record_id: string | null — reference to NetworkInterventionRecord for NETWORK_* faults

verification_requirement.statement: Fault injection MUST be independently verified — command success (returncode==0) is NOT sufficient evidence that a fault is measurably active. verify_injection() must be called after every inject() call, and its return value must be checked before using the record as experimental evidence.
verification_requirement.pipeline_rule: A FaultInjectionRecord with injection_verified=False MUST NOT be used as ground-truth evidence in RIFT evaluation. Such records are treated as ABORTED experiments.

NETWORK_LATENCY.method: ping/curl latency measurement before and after injection

PACKET_LOSS.method: tc packet drop counter before and after injection

SERVICE_DEGRADATION.method: CPU metric measurement via kubectl top

RESOURCE_CONTENTION.method: Memory metric measurement via kubectl top

DEPENDENCY_FAILURE.method: Health endpoint reachability check via curl

split_immutability_check.rule: The manifest split (DEVELOPMENT=36, VALIDATION=18, HELD_OUT_TEST=15, seed=42) is verified at module import time in fault_injector.py. Any mismatch raises RuntimeError before any experiment proceeds.
split_immutability_check.held_out_protection: FaultInjector.inject() raises ValueError for HELD_OUT_TEST scenarios unless allow_held_out=True (reserved for final evaluation only)

network_intervention_engine_integration.tc_approach: per-destination netem (u32 filter + child netem qdisc) — NOT global eth0 netem
network_intervention_engine_integration.isolation_guarantee: Only traffic to the target destination IP is affected; other service traffic is unaffected (satisfies intervention isolation requirement A5)
